build_merged_tree: git fetch origin <branch> <target>; merge origin/<branch> into a scratch worktree cut from the target tip fetched at gate start; python -m pip install -e .[test]
focused_vs_full: A -k or single-file selector only localizes a failure. The verdict rests on the whole pytest run.
zero_match_check: pytest --collect-only -q <selector> must list the intended tests; pytest --collect-only -q -k no_such_test_at_all must collect none
